limitations: Restricted to symmetric outer radii in the pure-tension double-brane holographic interface model. The lower endpoint is an infimum because the Israel inequalities are strict. No universal capacity upper bound or general equality characterization is claimed.
scientific_integrity: The result is an analytic consequence of the published double-brane formulas and strict Israel inequalities. The quantified theorem is proved symbolically; the bundled finite checks are corroborative only.
title: Exact capacity range at fixed entropy and transmission in symmetric double-brane conformal interfaces
